1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora que produce unas vainas largas con varias semillas rojas y duras, entre redondas y ovaladas, de pocos centímetros de longitud. Fabaceae; Canavalia rusioperma.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant that produces long pods containing several hard, red, and slightly rounded or oval seeds, a few centimeters in length. Fabaceae; Canavalia rusioperma.
